items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Ha, ha, ha, Moose. That's funny about the thing.

ctx.x: Moose, put your name down. We want to get your name today. What is it? Manuel Joseph Zango. Moose. Moose, okay.
Ha, ha, ha, Moose. That's funny about the thing. The average musician that got something kind of funny name.
Put a little Freddie Kepler down for him. Let him hear how he kept it.
